_note: Spoken-pronunciation lexicon for AVA's text-to-speech. Each key is a word (matched case-insensitively, whole-word only) and the value is a respelling that the voice engine pronounces correctly. This only affects how things SOUND when spoken aloud — the on-screen text keeps the real spelling. Extend this to teach AVA how to say names she keeps getting wrong.
_how: Use letters that sound out the way you want. Examples that test correctly in the engine: her own name AVA -> 'Aiva' (AY-vuh). For a person, e.g. 'jelani': 'Jeh-LAH-nee'. Add an entry, then restart the server.
_disable: Set AVA_PRON_LEXICON_OFF=1 to turn the whole lexicon off.
